# 大乘舍黎娑擔摩經

**ID:** T0711
**Volume:** T16
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 經集部
**Byline:** 宋 施護譯
**Dynasty:** 宋
**Date:** 980
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T0711

## Contributors
- 施護 (A000844)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T711 in one fascicle is the Northern Sòng translation of the *Śālistamba-sūtra* by the Indian monk [施護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%BD%E8%AD%B7) (Dānapāla, fl. 980–1017), the fourth of the seven Chinese versions. The transliterated title preserves the Sanskrit *śālistamba* phonetically as 舍黎娑擔摩 (the rendering 舍黎 reflects *śāli*, "rice"; 娑擔摩 reflects *stamba*, "stalk"). Dānapāla worked at the Sòng *Yìjīngyuàn* 譯經院 (Sūtra Translation Bureau) under imperial patronage; the date bracket reflects his attested translation activity in Chang-an / Kaifeng.

**Abstract**

Dānapāla's version translates the same Indian recension as Amoghavajra's [KR6i0402](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0402) / T710 but in a more conservative register, adhering closely to the Sanskrit syntax. The opening preserves the standard sūtra preface (一時佛在王舍城耆闍崛山中) and the encounter between Maitreya and Śāriputra. The twelve-link doctrine is again expounded through the rice-stalk metaphor, with paired internal/external causation. The translation is a useful philological control on the Tang versions.

The *Śālistamba* was a particularly favored text of the Sòng translation bureau — it had become a key Mahāyāna scriptural source for the equation of *pratītyasamutpāda* with *dharmakāya*, much cited in Madhyamaka and Yogācāra commentarial literature. The retranslation of this short sūtra in the late tenth century was therefore not redundant but a deliberate philological project to recover the original Sanskrit from a fresh Indic manuscript.

Related canonical Chinese versions of the *Śālistamba*: [KR6i0400](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0400) / T708 (Zhī Qiān, Wú), [KR6i0401](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0401) / T709 (anonymous, Eastern Jìn), [KR6i0402](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0402) / T710 (Amoghavajra, Tang), this work [KR6i0403](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0403) / T711 (Dānapāla, Sòng), [KR6i0404](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0404) / T712 (anonymous, Tang), [KR6i0405](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0405) / T2782 (commentary).
